briefdescription.para: Runs the Ground Reactions model; called by the Executive Can pass in a value indicating if the executive is directing the simulation to Hold.

parameterdescription.para: if true, the executive has been directed to hold the sim from advancing time. Some models may ignore this flag, such as the Input model, which may need to be active to listen on a socket for the "Resume" command to be given.

detaileddescription.para: Maintains a list of landing gear and ground contact points, all instances of FGLGear. Sums their forces and moments so that these may be provided to FGPropagate.
